Left at the unit and never sent: the same silence as a stall, a different place.
Lost in the tube and never received.

showcase_candidates.why: An alert on a specimen that arrived in time, the most convincing one: the highest risk at the alert.
Arrived on time and was rejected at accessioning: a failure Tracer cannot see.
Received within minutes of the window closing, the closest call.
A breach where the plan's baseline warned earlier than the risk model, an honest counterexample.
A tier 1 specimen (lavage or tissue) caught with a long warning, where the urgency weights count.
